_readme: STAGE-10 TASK 3 — the structured bug database. One record per observed defect.
Lives in the repository, NOT only in the factory DB: it must survive a DB wipe.
classification is one of: factory_defect | model_compliance | environment | unknown.
'unknown' is legitimate and expected. NEVER force a classification you cannot
evidence — a wrong label sends the next investigation in the wrong direction.
status is one of: open | explained | fixed.
Watch items from the K13 signature (STAGE-10-AGENT-BRIEF.md 'Watch items') are
'vii' (planner-skill domain neutrality) — evidence lands where the decision already is.
evidence_pointer must name the exact journal record, snapshot path, or DB row —
not prose about where to look.

schema.evidence_pointer: journal line / snapshot path / DB query — exact
